question: Under lawful nesting, does trace-admissible RT_n pass trace-admissibility into RT_{n+1} without exhaustive re-derivation from RT_core?

disposition.summary: Trace-admissibility is supported as a hereditary invariant under coherent nesting when RT_n is PRIN_001 trace-admissible, the continuation coupling satisfies PRIN_003, typed residue/non-collapse constraints are preserved, and GOV-RT-ZERO-RECOUPLING-001 is not violated.

formal_scaffold.candidate_rule: TraceAdm(RT_n) and LawfulNest(RT_n, continuation, x) => TraceAdm(RT_{n+1})

failure_conditions: RT_n is not trace-admissible under PRIN_001.
The nesting relation does not satisfy PRIN_003.
Continuation admissibility is undeclared or fails.
Typed residue is erased, aliased, or collapsed.
The inheritance claim is used to bypass local well-formedness or typed-continuation checks.
The result is treated as physical recurrence, conservation, or ontological permanence.

remaining_work: Convert the campaign-supported scaffold into a formal proof artifact if theorem promotion is requested.
Run independent rigor endorsement before raising the induction ceiling.
Keep continuation admissibility and base-case trace boundaries explicit for OQ_RTM_002 and OQ_RTM_003.
Audit all recursive-engine uses for attempts to bypass local well-formedness checks.

does_not_prove: Universal recursive soundness outside declared nesting controls.
